# Latter-day Stats

> An independent research site covering the Latter-day Saint community: creator statistics, curated academic studies, and a data explorer of survey/compiled datasets on Latter-day Saint demographics, belief, and culture. No institutional affiliation with The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, BYU, or any tracked creator.

Latter-day Stats tracks public YouTube statistics for Latter-day Saint creators, curates academic and journalistic research about the Latter-day Saint community, and hosts a data explorer of survey and compiled datasets with rendered chart graphics. All data is public and sourced with attribution; see the methodology page for selection criteria and data collection details.

## Core sections

- [Channels](https://latterdaystats.samuelbaird.com/channels): Latter-day Saint YouTube creators, with subscriber, view, and upload statistics refreshed regularly.
- [Studies](https://latterdaystats.samuelbaird.com/studies): Curated academic studies and research relating to the Latter-day Saint community, each with an abstract, key findings, and stated limitations.
- [Data Explorer](https://latterdaystats.samuelbaird.com/data-explorer): Survey and compiled datasets on Latter-day Saint demographics, belief, and culture, each with rendered chart graphics.
- [Methodology](https://latterdaystats.samuelbaird.com/methodology): How channels are selected, how statistics are collected, and how studies are curated.
- [About](https://latterdaystats.samuelbaird.com/about): Who runs the site and its independence policy.

## Notes for automated use

- The site is independent and not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
- Study entries summarize academic and journalistic sources; the `external_url` on each study page links to the original source, which should be cited in preference to this site when possible.
- Channel statistics are collected from the public YouTube Data API on a regular schedule and may lag real-time figures.

## Related projects by the same author

- [samuelbaird.com](https://samuelbaird.com/): home of the projects; see the [FAQ](https://samuelbaird.com/faq) and [open data](https://samuelbaird.com/data) (CC BY 4.0).
- [Sacred Sites Visited](https://samuelbaird.com/sacred-sites): map, photos and directory of places of worship visited in person.
- [Pulpit](https://pulpit.restorationcommons.org/): every General Conference discourse since 1830, graded for fidelity (a Restoration Commons project the author contributed to).
